historicalContext.programMaterialization: L1 is the post-ratification human program-materialization event (issues #19, #27 and #51–#58), not a lifecycle-less active node. L2 and L6 are roots under D6.3a.
historicalContext.sourceConflictDisposition: D6.4 records issue #19 saying L5 is next and L7 waits on L5, with #53/#55 open, while repository delivery is complete. Seed delivery from the bound repository evidence; issue status is neither delivery proof nor authorization. Historical interpretation and MAN-G03 association await the real PR-3 owner ceremony. Existing ADR acceptance actors are copied from INDEX.md, with recording-commit timestamps as provenance, not a newly performed acceptance.

rows.value: Adopt the security-first platform architecture by pinned reference
Use framework-neutral runner contracts and execution profiles
Treat agents as clients, not insiders
Separate sandbox capability, platform authorization, and safety policy
Separate agent implementation, execution profile, run, and automation
Route local, remote, and cloud execution explicitly
Use OpenFGA for relationship decisions and deterministic policy for safety
Define degraded mode and offline authorization posture
Use OKF for portable knowledge only
Keep the base runner provider-neutral and coding-agent images provider-specific
Adopt TypeScript, NestJS, and pnpm as the primary implementation stack
Promote durable lessons into canonical architecture and portable knowledge
Adopt OKF v0.2 as the source representation only, and keep packaging, query, and admission ours
Hybrid admission assurance for prohibited content
Classify asynchronous effects and enforce their semantics at runner boundaries
Separate orchestration-attempt, durable-fact, and finalization-transaction identity
Version and release knowledge sets as immutable compositions
Place runner-control by workload class — household control on the Pi, coding execution off it
Establish a machine-readable authority for mutable cross-cutting governance state
Decouple TypeScript policy enforcement from the lint engine
